queries.result: First-party discovery found the official Kebumen open-data catalog entry for Peta Bidang Tanah Tahun 2024, the Kebumen Geoportal, and ATR/BPN BHUMI/ATLAS. The catalog and portals establish public map/data infrastructure, but no anonymous parcel feature response with a safe native ID and full polygon was verified.

queries.result: First-party Indonesian-language discovery identified the same official Kebumen Peta Bidang Tanah Tahun 2024 catalog record and local Geoportal, plus ATR/BPN documentation describing BHUMI as the public land-map service.
